query.title: Company/business name
query.description: A Bahamas company/business name (or a distinctive fragment of one) to search for. Use a real, specific name -- very short/common words (e.g. "Bank", "Ltd") can time out server-side, see README.

queries.title: Names
queries.description: Multiple company/business names to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

includeHistory.title: Search former/historical names
includeHistory.description: If enabled, searches Bahamas' name-CHANGE history instead of current registered names (matches the RGD site's own "include history" toggle).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default (no WAF/TLS gate was found on this target, but it's kept for resilience).
